audience: warehouse and e-commerce teams that check stock and orders in StoreFeeder

useCases.title: Check stock for a SKU
useCases.text: Search products by SKU or EAN. Read one product with its suppliers, stock locations and barcodes.

useCases.title: Review the inventory log of a product
useCases.text: Read who changed the stock of one product, when and why, for a UTC date range.

useCases.title: Read a warehouse inventory report
useCases.text: List the warehouses. Then read the current inventory of every product in one warehouse, one page at a time.

useCases.title: Track orders and their status
useCases.text: Search orders by date, status, channel, warehouse or tracking number. Open one order to read its lines, totals and tracking.

useCases.title: Trace changes to an order
useCases.text: Read the change history of one order: who changed what, from which value to which, and when. Address, email, phone and customer changes show as removed.

useCases.title: Adjust stock or add an order note
useCases.text: Change the stock of a product by a number of units, with a reason. Or add a note with a subject and body to an order.
